note: Banco Promerica El Salvador's savings account rates and charges (undated, as published): a surcharge of 5.50 dollars for each month the account falls below its 25-dollar opening minimum, before VAT, whose rate the document doesn't give and which isn't added here; the debit card's monthly membership and per-transaction charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: Banco Promerica El Salvador, Tasas y comisiones de Cuentas de Ahorro
sources.said: Tasas y comisiones de Cuentas de Ahorro ... Recargo por no mantener el saldo mínimo de apertura de cuenta ... $ 5.50 por cada mes de incumplimiento de saldo mínimo ... corriente ( $100.00) y cuenta de ahorros ($25.00) ... Las comisiones y recargos no incluyen IVA.
